name: AddWeatherEffect
notes: Returned a placeholder handle in place of nothing in 2 cases of the nullability sweep (effectID: unknown rawcode, where: removed rect) on 3.0.0.24268: id 0 or -1, so a nil check does not catch it. The handle had id -1 for the unknown effect and id 0 for the removed rect, so a nil check does not tell that the effect is unknown or the rect was removed.
